item.title: Linuxiac Weekly Wrap-Up: Week 12, 2026 (Mar 16 – 22)
item.description: Catch up on the latest Linux news: Mageia 10 Beta, GNOME 50, Blender 5.1, Bcachefs 1.37, FFmpeg 8.1, systemd introduces birth date support, and more.

item.title: GrapheneOS Mobile Operating System Opposes OS-Level Age Checks
item.description: GrapheneOS, an open-source Android-based mobile OS, will not implement OS-level age verification, despite regulatory pressure.

item.title: Firefox 149 Now Available for Download, Brings Split View
item.description: Mozilla Firefox 149 improves PDF performance with hardware acceleration and introduces a new Split View feature for side-by-side browsing.

item.title: Garuda Linux Says No to Age Verification Outside Legal Requirement
item.description: Arch-based Garuda Linux clarifies its position on age verification and addresses concerns regarding systemd userdb and data management.

item.title: Qt 6.11 Released With Qt Canvas Painter and Task Tree Module
item.description: Qt 6.11 released with Qt Canvas Painter for 2D rendering, Task Tree module, and updates to graphs and 3D rendering.

item.title: DietPi 10.2 Released with Immich Support and New Software Options
item.description: DietPi 10.2 adds Immich, Immich Machine Learning, uv, and RustDesk Client, alongside tool improvements, configuration updates, and multiple bug fixes.

item.title: Krita 5.3 and Krita 6.0 Released With New Text Engine and Wayland HDR Support
item.description: Krita 5.3 delivers a new text engine and updated tools, alongside Krita 6.0, the Qt 6-based release with early Wayland support.

item.title: NVIDIA 595.58 Linux Driver Released With Multiple Kernel Crash Fixes
item.description: NVIDIA 595.58 is now available for download, resolving kernel crashes, X11 compositor flicker, and Wayland display wake issues on Linux systems.

item.title: GNOME 48.10 Released as Final Bugfix Update for GNOME 48
item.description: GNOME 48.10 is out as the last maintenance update in the GNOME 48 lifecycle, focusing on fixes across core components like Shell, GTK, and Mutter.

item.title: Mozilla Thunderbird 149 Brings Address Book Export and Multiple Bug Fixes
item.description: Mozilla Thunderbird 149 introduces address book export, improves EWS message sync, and resolves multiple bugs across email, calendar, and encryption features.
